OtherNames: Atlantic-See LNG FSRU; second Alexandroupolis FSRU (AKTOR/DEPA)
Location: Alexandroupolis area (Aegean Sea); location not yet finalized, sponsor focusing on Alexandroupolis with a second site under consideration
ResearcherNotesProject: New AKTOR(60%)/DEPA(40%) JV 'Atlantic SEE LNG Trade SA', formed Nov 2025 at the 6th PTEC conference in Athens. Signed a 20-year SPA with Venture Global (7 Nov 2025) for min 0.5 MTPA (potential expansion to up to ~4 bcm/y) of US LNG from 2030 - Greece's first long-term LNG SPA with a US exporter. Plans a dedicated 4.5-5 bcm/y FSRU; per S&P Global (Apr 2026 interview) and ProtoThema, location not yet finalized but focusing on Alexandroupolis with a second site under consideration; licensing procedures already started; FSRU order planned for autumn 2026; targeted operation late 2028/early 2029, no later than 2030. Distinct sponsor/SPA from the existing Gastrade Alexandroupolis and proposed Gastrade Thrace FSRUs - staged as a separate terminal, not a Gastrade unit. Capacity entered as 5.0 bcm/y (upper end of the stated 4.5-5 range); flagged yellow. Location/AssociatedTerminals provisional pending site finalization - see qa note.
Source: Venture Global IR (sponsor); ProtoThema; To Vima; S&P Global Commodity Insights
